atlas_description: Population-genomic inversion detection, karyotyping, and follow-up for the 226-sample pure C. gariepinus hatchery cohort.

pages.label: local PCA |z|
pages.tooltip: Local PCA on dosage. Sim_mat heatmap, robust |Z|, per-sample lines, K-means PCA, L3 contingency. THE big page.

pages.label: haplotype regimes
pages.tooltip: Long-range haplotype regimes (Stage 4 bruteforce projection). Run runBandingPipeline on the active chromosome and explore where each seed-band voter lands across target windows. Export the result as a regime catalogue JSON.

pages.label: ancestry scroller
pages.tooltip: Fish Ancestry Scroller — per-fish ancestry painting across one selected inversion candidate (one chromosome viewport). Three numbered layers (PC1 Band / Ancestry Bricks / Brick summary cohort) + 5-row brick-metrics heatmap + tab strip. Headline metric: mean |ΔQ| (global vs local). Consumes shared/ancestry_alignment.js (F-based label-switching alignment) + shared/ancestry_bricks.js (per-fish bricks + flags). See specs_todo/SPEC_fish_ancestry_scroller.md for UI layout v2.

pages.label: help
pages.tooltip: Quick-reference / help page (static HTML, no JS render). NB: legacy 'page5' is the help page, NOT multi-species — the multi-species cockpit is page16b.

pages.label: multi-species
pages.tooltip: Multi-species comparative atlas page (per HANDOFF_SUPPLEMENT).

pages.label: tree panel
pages.tooltip: Inversion-core sample tree (NJ on dosage distances) with cluster colouring and ARI-vs-clusters badge (HANDOFF_5).

pages.label: fingerprint track
pages.tooltip: Per-window diversity-regime fingerprint with rank-equivalence regime IDs, switch markers, fragment-proportions treemap, and architecture-scenario verdict (HANDOFF_6).

pages.label: similarity matrix
pages.tooltip: Per-window sample×sample similarity heatmap with block detection + adjacent-window ARI transition strip (HANDOFF_10).

pages.label: PCA scatter
pages.tooltip: Per-window PC1×PC2 scatter with cluster colouring and λ-magnitude scrubber (SPEC_0 §10 Phase 1).

pages.label: dosage heatmap
pages.tooltip: Sample × marker dosage heatmap with K=3 group track and polarity stripe. Accepts mgl_heatmap_json or legacy candidate-chunk shape via shared adapters (SPEC_0 §11).

pages.label: nested detector
pages.tooltip: Nested-inversion detector with 3 stratum tracks (HOM1 / HET / HOM2) and contiguous inner-interval overlays (HANDOFF_7).

pages.label: dosage cluster
pages.tooltip: Adaptive-K sample clustering on per-window dosage profiles, with per-K scoring table and cluster mean-curve display (HANDOFF_8).

pages.label: polarize · MSA
pages.tooltip: Stacked-consensus MSA view of the inversion: outgroup row + INV founder-like consensus row + per-subgroup consensus rows (from 2D-SFS doubleton hierarchical clustering) + STD consensus row. Confidence + reason tier per site.

pages.label: haplotype network
pages.tooltip: Minimum-spanning haplotype network of INV chromosomes. Nodes are Hamming-radius clusters; edges are pairwise mutational distance. Node colour matches the 2D-SFS doubleton subgroup.

pages.label: polarize · synteny
pages.tooltip: Outgroup-synteny polarization: per-outgroup-species break-point orientation vote (HOM_A / HOM_B / unresolved), aggregated to an arrangement verdict.

pages.label: age + divergence
pages.tooltip: Per-candidate age estimate: dXY between arrangements, private variant density on the derived class, MRCA depth, segregating-sites summary.

pages.label: mosaicism / leakage
pages.tooltip: Recombinant-tract / polarity-switch detector on INV chromosomes. Per-sample per-window mosaic-call + summary leakage score.

pages.label: internal history
pages.tooltip: Sub-PCA on derived-only samples: looks for haplotype clusters / nested rearrangements / sublineages inside the inversion class.

pages.label: layer cleaning
pages.tooltip: Layer 0/1 noise removal: kinship + family-size downweighting + hatchery-duplicate exclusion so close relatives don't double-count in deep-Layer-2 stats.

pages.label: event tree
pages.tooltip: Relative-ordering inference across multiple inversions on the same chromosome — carrier-overlap nesting, internal diversity ranking, outgroup presence, age class chaining.

pages.label: archaeology card
pages.tooltip: Per-candidate synthesis card: pulls together polarity, age class, integrity, mosaicism, frequency, π/dXY/FST, private/fixed counts, and confidence into one screen — the Step-6 verdict.

server._doc: Server moved to atlas-core/server/ (turn 'core-server-unify'). Every endpoint here (popstats / LD / dosage / file / compute) is generic plumbing — the inversion atlas reaches it the same way every other atlas will. See atlas-core/server/SERVER_README.md.

_stylesheets_chrome_doc: atlas_chrome.css is a generic chrome stylesheet (tab pills + settings button + active-stage folding) shipped here as a CANDIDATE FOR PROMOTION to atlas-core. Pairs with shared/atlas_chrome.js. Other atlases can drop the same two files in. When atlas-core ships its own copy, remove this entry + delete the cartridge copy.
_stylesheets_doc: Atlas-wide stylesheets, loaded by the shell at atlas-register time. Currently one big bundle (extracted verbatim from the legacy monolith). Future work: split into per-page stylesheets (atlases/inversion/css/pages/page1.css etc.) and reference them from each page entry's `stylesheet` field below — the router loads page-stylesheet on mount.
_scope_pickers_doc: Pickers rendered in the shell's #scopebar (sticky strip below the topbar). Each picker drives an AtlasState slot via setActiveChrom / setActiveCandidate / generic emit. `auto_options_from: <root_name>` makes the dropdown discover its options at runtime via GET /api/precomp_index?root=<root_name> — the server walks the pipeline output dir and returns whichever chromosomes have an atlas JSON on disk. No manual list to maintain; add a new chrom to the pipeline output and it shows up in the dropdown on next page load. (A static `options: [...]` array is still supported for pickers that aren't backed by a precomp root.)

stages.label: discovery 1
stages._doc: Round-1 discovery: the local-PCA detection pipeline (|z|, θπ, GHSL). Other discovery panels — dosage heatmap, PCA scatter, similarity matrix, fingerprint track, haplotype regimes, tree panel, nested detector, dosage cluster — live in 'discovery_2'. Per-window summary table + negative regions catalogue moved to 'catalogue'.

stages.label: discovery 2
stages._doc: Round-2 discovery: workflow surfaces for per-candidate deep-dive and the v3.4 banding pipeline runner. Currently page2 (candidate focus) + haplotype_regimes (was page22 until 2026-05-16). The utility / inspector cartridges (tree panel, fingerprint track, similarity matrix, PCA scatter, dosage heatmap, nested detector, dosage cluster) moved to 'tooling' on 2026-05-16 — see AUDIT_local_pca_merge_vs_rename.md §Q3.

stages.label: tooling
stages._doc: Utility / inspector cartridges. Open these to characterise a candidate, debug a layer, or compare evidence axes. Distinct from discovery_2's workflow pages. Pages currently in this stage: tree_panel, fingerprint_track, similarity_matrix, pca_scatter_per_window, dosage_heatmap, nested_inversion_detector, dosage_cluster_adaptive_k (re-staged from discovery_2 on 2026-05-16 per AUDIT_local_pca_merge_vs_rename.md §Q3). Future additions: page_pca_comparator (per SPEC_local_pca_comparator.md). Atlas-core shell may render this stage as a vertical sidebar rather than horizontal pills — that's a shell-side change tracked separately.

stages.label: classification
stages._doc: Absorbs the legacy 'refinement' + 'classification' + 'synthesis' stages — the per-candidate karyotype/tier deep-dive, popstats/ancestry tracks, boundary refinement, SV evidence, plus the cohort-level stats profile / marker panel / overview pages that previously lived under 'synthesis'.

stages.label: evolution
stages._doc: Per-candidate evolution stage: polarize ancestral vs derived arrangement, reconstruct founder-like / MRCA-like consensus, build haplotype networks of INV chromosomes, estimate age + leakage + internal substructure. All cartridges consume the existing mgl_adapter primitives (PCA / dosage / heatmap / nj-tree) plus a small set of evolution-specific helpers (founder_consensus, doubleton_sfs_clusters, haplotype_network, outgroup_synteny, inversion_age, mosaicism_detector).
